chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Aban ibn Uthman from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) led us in prayer, reciting the Fatihah of the Book and the end of the Surah Al-Ma'idah. When he finished the salutation, he turned to us and said, 'Indeed, I only intended to teach you.'
ai.seo_question: What was the purpose of the Imam's specific recitation during the prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the pedagogical role of the Imams, demonstrating that their liturgical practices were deliberate instructional acts for the community. By explicitly stating his intent to teach, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the importance of following the Prophet's and Imams' specific methods of recitation and prayer structure as a source of religious authority.
